work.pause.title: pause this work
work.pause.ask.stops: Stops {{count}} running session now and starts nothing of {{what}} on this machine until you resume it. Its tree keeps what it wrote, and a quest it took stays taken here.
work.pause.ask.stops_other: Stops {{count}} running sessions now and starts nothing of {{what}} on this machine until you resume it. Their trees keep what they wrote, and the quests they took stay taken here.
work.pause.ask.elsewhere: Another machine may still take {{quests}}: a pause holds this machine only.
work.pause.ask.intake: Its intake keeps reading; what it publishes waits too.
work.pause.reading: Reading what the pause would stop…
work.pause.nothing: Nothing of {{what}} is open or taken on this machine, so there is nothing to pause.
work.pause.done.stopped: Paused {{what}} and stopped {{count}} session: nothing of it starts on this machine until you resume it.
work.pause.done.stopped_other: Paused {{what}} and stopped {{count}} sessions: nothing of it starts on this machine until you resume it.
work.pause.done.nothingStopped: Paused {{what}}: nothing of it starts on this machine until you resume it.
work.pause.done.already: Already paused: nothing of {{what}} starts on this machine until you resume it.
work.pause.unreached: Could not stop session {{session}}: Stop… on its page asks again.
work.pause.resumed: Resumed {{what}}: the driver's next look plans its work as it would have.
work.pause.notPaused: Not paused on this machine, so nothing of {{what}} changed.
work.pause.stillSitMany: {{count}} quest of it still sits; its page says why, under Sitting.
work.pause.stillSitMany_other: {{count}} quests of it still sit; each quest's page says why, under Sitting.
